inputs.wire_kind: required one signed int64 Integer for every field; no coercion/default/null/missing fields

domain.scope: positive signed int64 opaque same-context key
domain.priority: full signed int64; equality only, no numeric ranking/arithmetic

inputs.receipt_binding: Bind raw corpus and native-input document bytes/SHA; each case index and both Rule port entity IDs/ordered8 field IDs/names/exact int64 values must match originals in execute and saved replay. Input-only data contains no expected results.

output.echoes: No duplicate result echoes: all16 original signed int64 values are retained and validated in the receipt delivery inputs, including invalid-domain extrema.

semantics.valid: both rule domains valid; no arithmetic or prefix conversion before this check
semantics.invalid: all16 original receipt input integers unchanged; all6 output Boolean fields false; all4 witness octets0; reason0
semantics.comparable: valid and exact scope equality and exact priority equality
semantics.overlap: for valid inputs, network-prefix overlap independent of scope/priority; false when invalid
semantics.opposing_effect: for valid inputs, effect values differ independent of scope/priority; false when invalid
semantics.conflict: valid and comparable and overlap and opposing_effect
semantics.witness_valid: exactly conflict, not merely comparable overlap
semantics.witness: if conflict, canonical network address of more-specific prefix (larger bits); tie selects left. Must be contained by both valid prefixes. Otherwise4zeros and witness_valid=false
semantics.host_bits: preserve original input host bits; network comparisons and witness masking ignore only unspecified host bits
semantics.zero_address: 0.0.0.0 valid IPv4; with witness_valid=true can be a real witness, distinct from non-witness4zero sentinel

reason_priority.name: PRIORITY_MISMATCH
reason_priority.condition: valid and scopes equal and priorities unequal

reason_priority.name: DISJOINT
reason_priority.condition: valid and comparable and not overlap

reason_priority.name: SAME_EFFECT
reason_priority.condition: valid and comparable and overlap and not opposing_effect

reason_priority.name: CONFLICT
reason_priority.condition: valid and comparable and overlap and opposing_effect

scope_contract: Caller must assign the same positive scope only for the same tenant/action/principal/protocol/port and other relevant policy context, with stable revision binding.
Gooo checks only positive int64/equality. It does not verify the truth, authenticity, uniqueness or freshness of caller scope/context.
This equal-priority pair contract deliberately excludes longest-prefix-wins/deny-overrides/ordered-rule resolution.
non_claims: conflict=false when invalid or not comparable is not permission, safety, comparison success or proof of a conflict-free ACL
Only a finite pair of supplied rules is examined; no whole ACL, actual request, connected peer, network send, host adapter, ledger or production safety guarantee
No human approval protocol is part of this pure deterministic calculation

oracle_interface.calculation: Independent pinned Go1.27.2 net/netip PrefixFrom/Overlaps/Masked/Contains; int64 guards before byte/int conversion; do not reproduce Gooo arithmetic formula

engine_constraint.mapping: Original16 integers are preserved in receipt inputs; no duplicate output echoes. Declaration checking alone does not establish native execution.
